summary: Task 2 (visual layer with mock data) and Task 3 (Object Storage document repository) fully validated end-to-end. All 10 backend document API tests pass (pytest). All 7 new content pages render with expected data-testids and mock item counts. Header nav uses <Link> and route highlighting works. /perfil auth-gate works both directions (redirect to /join when unauth; renders profile-page when authed with community cookie). Admin document upload/list/filter/delete UI flows work. Investor portal renders portal-documents-section + count + download button when investor docs exist. Existing pages /capital, /executive-summary, /investor-pitch-deck, /join, and home slider still work.
critical_code_review_comments: auth/login (routes/auth_routes.py) lowercases the incoming email before find_one, but the users collection stores email as-is. Any seed that stores mixed-case email will silently fail login (encountered while seeding TEST_investor_docs). Consider normalizing email on write (both admin seed and accept-invitation already lowercase; investor upserts and future manual seeds should too, or the find_one should be case-insensitive).
Header.jsx: NavItem `active` uses startsWith on location.pathname. This is OK for /noticias but means /investor-pitch-deck could match a future /investor nav item; verify when more routes are added.
AdminDocumentsPage delete uses window.confirm — fine for MVP but should be replaced with the shared shadcn dialog for parity with the rest of the admin UI.

InvestorPortalPage.jsx does the download via raw fetch with Authorization header, then creates an object URL — good approach; however no error toast if fetch fails (only setError). Consider surfacing to the user via a temporary notice.

If you need to test investor role again, either use existing sofia.investor@example.com (password unknown to me, was set during earlier iteration) or seed a new user with lowercase email and a bcrypt hash (see the routes/auth_routes.py — login lowercases email before find_one).
rca of the issue: Investigated one transient issue during frontend flow: seeding a portal document from within the same Playwright script failed because the admin login redirect race left localStorage not yet populated when navigating to /admin/documents. Worked around by uploading via curl in a follow-up run; the underlying admin upload path is verified working by pytest (test_admin_upload_returns_public_doc) and by an earlier successful UI upload. Not a real bug.
